node.statement: Common multiplier estimate, using node 1.2 explicitly. For every W in calU, def-approximate-unitary-space gives W^dagger bold-dot W=J and a right inverse, while def-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives (1-e)||W||^2<=1 and ||L_{W^dagger}L_W-I||<=e||W||^2<=e/(1-e)<1/5. Thus L_W is injective and, because calX is finite-dimensional, bijective. Moreover ||L_{W^dagger}||<=(1+e)||W||<=7/5 and ||L_{W^dagger}L_W Z||>=(4/5)||Z||, so ||L_W Z||>=(4/7)||Z|| and ||L_W^{-1}||<=7/4. All inequalities use only e<1/6 from node 1.2 and exact unitality.
